description: Begin an out-of-band file upload. Returns a presigned R2 PUT URL and the headers to use; the file bytes are uploaded directly to storage, never through this channel. After PUTting the file, call confirm_attachment_upload with the returned attachment_id. Supports listings (photos, documents), users (avatar), and pages (cover, photos). Avatars pass an automated content check before they appear publicly.

attachable_id.description: Identifier of the attachable resource. For "listing" pass the listing hashid (e.g. "d5yqqgoa") — the same id every read tool returns. For "user" pass "me" to attach to yourself. For "page" pass its numeric id.

attachable_type.description: Morph alias of the resource to attach to: "listing", "user", or "page".

collection.description: Optional explicit collection: "photos", "documents", "avatar", or "cover". Omit to auto-route by MIME (images→photos, PDFs→documents; documents are PDF only). Singleton slots (avatar/cover) must be set explicitly.

content_type.description: MIME type of the file, e.g. "image/jpeg" or "application/pdf". Must match the collection whitelist.

filename.description: Original filename including extension, e.g. "front-elevation.jpg". Used to derive the storage key and extension.

size.description: Exact byte size of the file. Verified against the uploaded object at confirm time, so it must be accurate.

name: sign_attachment_upload
title: Sign attachment upload
